shared_elements: vertical axis with lateral elements arranged along it
tall rectangular field filled with a repeating ornament
justification: Both surfaces carry a repeating frond-like ornament organised along a vertical axis filling a tall panel, so at a coarse level both could be read as stylised plant/branch decoration running the length of the field. But A depicts specific curvilinear botanical forms \u2013 palmettes, lotus-like buds and spiral rosettes on undulating stems, rendered in rounded modelled relief \u2013 whereas B shows only angular incised chevron/herringbone bands with no flowers, rosettes or discernible stems, a wholly geometric and schematic convention.
